asserts.expr: (function(){var out=[];var trs=document.querySelectorAll('table tbody tr');for(var i=0;i<trs.length;i++){var b=trs[i].querySelector('[id$="-status"]');if(b)out.push(String(b.innerText||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim());}return out.sort().join(',');})()

(function(){var trs=document.querySelectorAll('table tbody tr');var n=0;for(var i=0;i<trs.length;i++){var b=trs[i].querySelector('[id$="-status"]');if(b&&/^Pending$/.test(String(b.innerText||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim())&&!b.querySelector('.animate-spin'))n++;}return n;})()

(function(){var trs=document.querySelectorAll('table tbody tr');var bad=0;for(var i=0;i<trs.length;i++){var b=trs[i].querySelector('[id$="-status"]');if(!b)continue;var t=String(b.innerText||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();var spin=!!b.querySelector('.animate-spin');if(t==='Pending'&&!spin)bad++;if((t==='Active'||t==='Inactive')&&spin)bad++;}return bad;})()

(function(){var trs=document.querySelectorAll('table tbody tr');var n=0;for(var i=0;i<trs.length;i++){var b=trs[i].querySelector('[id$="-status"]');if(b&&/^Active$/.test(String(b.innerText||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim()))n++;}return n;})()
